newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-FUSER IS ITALY'S LATEST CASUALTY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FUSER IS ITALY'S LATEST CASUALTY.

text.p: Italy's World Cup campaign suffered another setback on Monday when midfielder Diego Fuser was ruled out of Saturday's opening European group two qualifier against Moldova because of injury.

The 27-year-old Lazio player, called up on Sunday, was examined by doctors when he arrived at the national squad training ground at Coverciano near Florence and ordered rest and physiotherapy for a muscle strain in his left leg.
Italy are away to Moldova on October 5 and at home to Georgia on October 9 -- their first games since their failure to progress beyond the opening phase of the European championship.
Coach Arrigo Sacchi, under pressure to perform following the Euro 96 debacle in England, was struggling to put together a strong midfield even before Fuser's injury became apparent.
Alessandro Del Piero of Juventus and AC Milan's Demetrio Albertini will also miss Saturday's game through injury.
Del Piero, who twisted his left knee in the opening minute of the serie A win over Fiorentina on Sunday, will be out of action for three weeks, doctors said.
